title: Diwali in Jaipur 2026: The Pink City After Dark, Illuminated Bazaars and What to Plan
summary: What diwali in jaipur 2026 looks like. The bazaar illumination competition, Hawa Mahal lit up, Nahargarh silhouette, and a 2 day festival plan.
body_markdown:
Jaipur’s municipal government does something during Diwali that no other Indian city does at this scale. It runs an official illumination competition between the merchant associations of the walled city’s historic bazaars. Johari Bazaar, Bapu Bazaar, Tripolia Bazaar and Kishanpole Bazaar each compete to produce the most decorated, most brilliantly lit stretch of market. The result is that the entire old city, a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2019, transforms into a continuous lit corridor where the architecture itself becomes the canvas.


This is not a government event you watch from a designated viewing area. It is a city that you walk through. The experience is available to anyone standing on the street, and it runs every evening from Dhanteras through Diwali night.


## **What Makes Diwali in Jaipur Distinct**


Most Indian cities celebrate Diwali in homes and at specific temple or community gathering points. Diwali in jaipur 2026 spreads across the entire old city infrastructure. The Hawa Mahal is illuminated. Nahargarh Fort on the hilltop is lit and visible from the old city streets after sunset. City Palace and Jantar Mantar sit within the illuminated zone. The bazaar lighting, the heritage architecture and the fort backdrop combine into a cityscape that photographs differently from any other Diwali destination.


# **Diwali in Jaipur 2026: The Festival Experience, Day by Day**


Diwali 2026 falls on Sunday, November 8. The Jaipur celebration window runs from Dhanteras on Friday, November 6 through Diwali night on November 8.


## **Dhanteras Evening: November 6**


Dhanteras is the biggest commercial day of the Diwali cluster in Jaipur. Johari Bazaar, the jewellery market, is the centre of gravity. Gold and silver buying peaks, and the shops illuminate their frontages to draw foot traffic. The bazaar streets are packed from late afternoon until well past 10 PM.


The Dhanteras walk through Johari Bazaar is the first genuine moment when the illumination competition becomes visible. Each shop front carries its own lighting installation, and the collective effect along the 500-metre stretch creates an unbroken corridor of light.


For those not shopping for jewellery, Tripolia Bazaar’s brass and lacquerware section is worth the Dhanteras visit. Buying metal items on Dhanteras is auspicious, and the traditional Rajasthani brassware, including decorative diyas, puja thalis and brass lamps, is both practical and culturally specific.


## **Choti Diwali: November 7**


The evening before Diwali is when the old city reaches its visual peak. The bazaar illumination is complete. Fireworks begin after sunset, and the sound continues through the night. The Hawa Mahal, visible from the junction of Johari Bazaar and the main road, is fully lit and serves as the visual anchor of the old city.


The rooftop restaurants and cafes along Tripolia Road and near the Hawa Mahal area offer elevated views of the lit city. Several heritage hotels in the walled city open their terraces for Diwali evening events with Rajasthani food, folk music and a view of the fireworks.


The walk from Hawa Mahal through the old city lanes towards the City Palace, with the illuminated bazaars on both sides and Nahargarh Fort visible on the ridge above, is the specific Jaipur Diwali moment that makes the trip worth the planning.


## **Diwali Night: November 8**


Diwali morning in Jaipur is for temple visits and family puja. Most shops in the old city close by early afternoon for the Lakshmi Puja preparations. The Lakshmi Puja muhurat in Jaipur for 2026 is approximately 6:03 PM to 7:59 PM, after which the fireworks intensify and the city settles into the evening celebration.


For visitors, the morning hours are best used for the heritage sights: Amber Fort, City Palace museum, and Jantar Mantar. The afternoon is quiet. The evening is festive.


## **What to See Beyond the Bazaars**


### **Nahargarh Fort After Dark**


Nahargarh Fort sits on the Aravalli ridge above the old city. During Diwali, the fort is lit and its silhouette against the night sky, with the lit city spreading below, is one of the defining views of Jaipur. The fort is accessible by road, though check whether the road is open after dark during Diwali.


### **Amber Fort**


Amber Fort, about 11 km from the city centre, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site under the Hill Forts of Rajasthan inscription of 2013. November temperatures make the full exploration comfortable without the summer heat. Visit in the morning before heading into the old city for the evening.


### **Birla Mandir**


Birla Mandir, built in white marble below the Moti Dungri hill, is illuminated during Diwali and the evening aarti draws a larger-than-usual congregation.


## **Where to Stay**


Hotels in the walled city area give the closest access to the bazaar illumination and the walking route. Heritage havelis converted to boutique hotels along Johari Bazaar and near the City Palace offer the most atmospheric Diwali stay.


Book at least 2 to 3 weeks before Diwali. Jaipur hotel rates during the festival week run 30 to 50 percent above the October baseline.


## **How to Reach Jaipur**


Jaipur is connected to Delhi by bus, roughly 5 to 6 hours. The[Jaipur bus booking page](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/jaipur-bus-booking-online) shows current schedules and fares. A Friday evening departure from Delhi arrives in Jaipur by late night, giving the full Dhanteras-to-Diwali window.


Jaipur’s railway station and airport are both within 15 km of the old city.


Prices are approximate and may vary based on season, demand, and availability.


## **Common Questions About Diwali in Jaipur**


### **When is diwali in jaipur 2026?**


Diwali in Jaipur falls on Sunday, November 8, with the festival window running from Dhanteras on November 6 through Diwali night.


### **What is the bazaar illumination competition in Jaipur?**


The municipal government runs an official competition between Johari, Bapu, Tripolia and Kishanpole bazaar merchant associations for the best Diwali lighting.


### **Is Hawa Mahal illuminated during Diwali?**


Hawa Mahal is fully illuminated during the Diwali period and serves as the visual anchor of the old city’s festival lighting.


### **Can I see Nahargarh Fort lit up during Diwali?**


Nahargarh Fort is lit during Diwali and its silhouette above the illuminated old city is one of the defining views of Jaipur.


### **What is the best evening for Diwali photography in Jaipur?**


Choti Diwali evening on November 7 is the visual peak, when the bazaar illumination is complete and fireworks begin against the lit heritage backdrop.


### **Where should I stay for Diwali in Jaipur?**


Heritage havelis in the walled city near Johari Bazaar or City Palace give the closest access to the illuminated bazaar walking route.


### **How do I reach Jaipur from Delhi for Diwali?**


The Delhi to Jaipur bus takes roughly 5 to 6 hours. A Friday evening departure arrives in time for the Dhanteras celebrations.


### **Is Amber Fort worth visiting during Diwali?**


Amber Fort is best visited on the morning of Diwali day when shops close for puja. November weather makes the full fort walk comfortable.


### **What time is Lakshmi Puja in Jaipur 2026?**


The Lakshmi Puja muhurat in Jaipur for Diwali 2026 is approximately 6:03 PM to 7:59 PM on November 8.


### **How early should I book hotels for Diwali in Jaipur?**


Book at least 2 to 3 weeks before Diwali. Festival week rates in Jaipur run 30 to 50 percent above the October baseline.
